analysis: New England is a massive Elo favorite (+11.7 pts) but that's almost entirely a prior-season artifact -- real 2026 scoring form has these teams within 0.3 points of each other, and the sim itself flags the 11.4-pt divergence between those two views as worth a second look rather than trusting the Elo number. Las Vegas also gets a documented discount for Ashton Jeanty (ankle/foot, questionable, lead back) with no Friday practice detail found.

New info this cycle cuts hard against New England covering as big a favorite as Elo suggests: the Patriots are down four cornerbacks (Christian Gonzalez, Carlton Davis III, Channing Canada, Karon Prunty all ruled out) plus WR Mack Hollins. That's a genuine defensive-cluster injury, and this model only knows how to dock the injured team's OWN offensive projection -- it has no mechanism to raise the opponent's expected scoring against a gutted secondary, so the total here should be read a bit higher than the raw sim number, and the spread case for the Raiders' points is stronger than the Elo-driven market number implies.
